title: Materialize P104 in 12 private slots while preserving every native query
body:
PR5812 declares28 owned labels with13 simultaneous lifetimes. This package removes dead private work, places INIT/CLEAR at actual first/last use, and emits the complete caller using12 physical slots. A12-way simultaneous-set certificate proves the minimum for this fixed trimmed chronology. The scalar allowance falls225026→224976 per call, or900 across18 calls.

The source-pinned PR5763 allocator is applied to actual source operations, not hypothetical lifetimes. Full782-axis forward and611524-coefficient reverse checks pass. Every one of21663 public source observations and every exact native payload/frame agrees with the source. All paid ranks, helper targets and public boundaries remain fixed. Controls reject a live-slot collision and a missing dirty-slot INIT.

Normal/optimized registered replay, exact committed bytes, source hashes, package export and read-only Git-free replay pass. The native-phase and outer caller proofs remain source dependencies, with exact query preservation shown here; they were not rerun. The old positive allowance remains conservative. No new kappa, universal space floor or selected-frontier change is claimed. Hosted CI and independent admission remain separate.

Retain David Arias, Cinna Davis, Gareth Davidson, Dugongue, the complete P104 source credits in inputs/NOTICE, and PR5763. New source-specific construction by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents.
